svg.text: mcring v1 — sheet 1/5: Power: cell + charging pigtails (J1/J3 headers), charger, buck, battery sense
net-label schematic generated by hardware/electrical/schematic_svg.py from mcring_v1.py — 26 parts on this sheet
grey pin numbers are to be VERIFIED against the datasheets; red = power net, green = GND, blue = signal, x = NC, grey 'spare' = free GPIO; dashed grey box + * = off-board part wired to the board
• BQ25100: R_ISET 9.1k -> ~25 mA (K_ISET 230 A*ohm, VERIFY); R_PRETERM 11.5k -> 1 mA (K 11.5, VERIFY).
• BQ25100 has PRE_TERM, no TS pin (TS variant = BQ25101). nCHG -> IO3 (PIN_CHG, active low) + TP7, 100k pull-up.
• TPS62840: R12 267k from VSET to GND = 3.3 V code (SLVSE12 Table 1); MODE/STOP low; EN tied to VBAT.
• Charging input: CP1/CP2 band contacts (off-board, dashed) -> W2 pigtail -> J3 Pico-EZmate header -> D2 bidirectional TVS -> D3 series
• Schottky -> CHG_IN. D3 blocks a ring seated the wrong way round in the 2-pin cradle. J3 pin 1 doubles as the bring-up VBUS entry.
• Cell BT1 (off-board) -> W1 pigtail -> J1 Pico-EZmate header (top side; no solder). Battery divider 1 M / 1 M + 100 nF: 2.1 uA.
• 100 uF 1206 bulk on 3V3 near the module absorbs the 300-370 mA capture/radio peaks.
